title: Left board friction
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the static friction force from the left board as 15 N.

title: Inter-book friction coefficient
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum coefficient of kinetic friction between books as 0.25.

title: Vertical extraction force
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum vertical force to extract the second book as 25 N.

title: System force balance
description: Important: Applies vertical force equilibrium to the entire book stack, recognizing total friction from both boards equals total weight.

title: Individual book equilibrium
description: Important: Analyzes forces on the leftmost book (or second book) to relate inter-book friction to board friction and weight.

title: Friction force definition
description: Important: Correctly applies f = μN, using the normal force from the clamping pressure to find the inter-book coefficient.

title: Force composition for extraction
description: Optional: Correctly sums the forces (friction from adjacent books and weight) needed to overcome when pulling the second book vertically.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the direction of friction forces on individual books or confuses which forces are balanced.

title: Normal force confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect normal force (e.g., book weight instead of clamping pressure) when calculating inter-book friction coefficient.
